title: AI News, Monday October 12
desc:
Good morning Ryan, and a very happy Monday, October twelfth. Welcome back to your AI news station. It's a big one today, so grab a coffee, maybe a second one, and let's settle in. We've got Netflix talking openly about AI in the edit, new video tools that live inside the chat window, a fresh flagship video model, a prize-winning AI trailer heading for the big screen, some sobering news about AI agents on the open web, and a little Final Cut Pro gossip to finish. As always, I'll tell you why each one matters for you, at Metronome, and in your own work at EMRGNT.
